insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to ensure they are filtering by metafields that are properly set up. This change helps prevent incorrect results and makes it easier to debug queries. Developers can test their queries in the GraphQL Admin API to identify any potential issues. They should also review their error handling to ensure it can handle the new error responses.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate query results, which can lead to better decision-making and more effective use of their Shopify data.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, making it easier for developers to build robust and effective Shopify integrations.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: 'my_metafield', value: 'my_value' } }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes on Product, Order, Customer, Collection, and Location, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages, as part of the Liquid July ’26 developer preview.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package version 13.0.2 adds non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags to hydrogen link and allows bypassing confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include the use of a unique name for each app, reducing merchant confusion over identical app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports the channelId argument, allowing for the application of a specific sales channel’s context to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields, providing more information about exchange line items.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API version 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components, allowing apps to access component-level discount allocations from bundle line items.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Webhooks, and Liquid templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring accurate results. Additionally, metafield triggers and new event topics are available for subscription, including Order, Collection, and Location events.

themes.title: Improved Development Tools
themes.detail: Liquid templates have been updated to support composing pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page development. Furthermore, full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, streamlining the development process.

actions.text: Update API version to 2026-10 to utilize new GraphQL Admin API features
Explore new event topics and metafield triggers for Webhooks integration
Migrate to new Liquid template features for theme development
